messages:
kevin: Kicking off a quiet-window deploy for v2026.03. Canary to 10% in eu-west. Please monitor SLOs (https://dash.redwood.local/slo/serve) and surface any p95 or 5xx regressions quickly.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by kevin. Canary 10% -> eu-west-1. Version: v2026.03. CI: green. Notifying @eng-oncall.

maria: saw p95 for embeds route jump to ~390ms ~90s ago (normally ~210ms). No 5xx yet.

liz: checking error rates: `sum(increase(http_requests_total{job="serve",route="/embeds"}[1m])) by (status)` -> 200 steady, 500 ~1 in last 5m. small.

ops-sre: if p95 stays >350ms for next 5m, pause ramp and consider rollback. Also check kv cache hit ratio; new shard mapping might cause cold misses.

kevin: pausing ramp. @deploy-bot hold-ramp. Adding a line in release notes about eu-west perf variability.

deploy-bot: Hold acknowledged. Canary remains at 10%.

maria: kv_cache_hit_ratio{region="eu-west-1",service="embeds"} reads 0.6, baseline ~0.88. Starting prewarm recommended.

liz: I can run `tools/prewarm_kv --region eu-west-1 --service embeds --target=0.85`. Need ops okay.

ops-sre: go ahead. I'll watch for 5xx. If prewarm doesn't restore hit ratio in 10m we'll roll back to v2026.02.

jen: kicked prewarm job. initial fill logs show steady warming.

maria: p95 dropping -> 250ms, kv hit -> 0.77. No spike in 5xx.

liz: noticed one proxy pod with higher latency, restarted it; errors cleared.

ops-sre: pod restart complete. p95 ~230ms, kv hit 0.81. Recommend ramp to 25% with a 5m hold.

kevin: @deploy-bot ramp-to 25% over 2m, hold 5m. Resume release notes draft.

deploy-bot: Ramp command accepted. I'll abort ramp if p95 >350ms or 5xx >alert thresholds.

maria: continuing to watch. will update release note line: "During canary we observed transient eu-west latency tied to cache warmup; prewarm mitigated and rollout resumed."

kevin: thanks team. Keep monitoring for 15m then we push full rollout if green. :thumbsup:
